name: KEGE Reader — fluid text + PiP for kompege.ru
summary: Fluid readable layout and a picture-in-picture window for kompege.ru tasks and course homework.
description:
KEGE Reader improves reading of kompege.ru tasks (ЕГЭ practice site).

Features:
- Fluid layout of task text: the task is re-typeset into a readable column of any width (works in split-screen windows), with proper math (KaTeX), tables, and code.
- Picture-in-picture (PiP) window: the task renders into a real video stream, so the window floats above all windows, including fullscreen video. Move the PiP bar by dragging; zoom, copy, download.
- Works on the classic task pages (/task/NNNNN) and on the course homework pages (/jobs/...) — mini PiP buttons appear on the task number strip; Alt+Left/Right switches tasks inside the PiP.
- Task images (including CDN-hosted) are drawn into the PiP canvas via CORS or a background fetch relay, keeping the stream untainted.

All processing is local; see the privacy policy and the public source repository.

---

Расширение улучшает чтение задач на kompege.ru: переносит текст задачи в «резиновую» колонку любой ширины, рисует задачи в PiP-окне поверх всех окон (включая полноэкранное видео), поддерживает страницы домашки курса и картинки с CDN. Вся обработка локальная, исходники открыты.

release_notes.en-US: First AMO release: fluid layout, PiP window, homework (/jobs) mini-PiP, cross-origin CDN images via CORS/background-fetch relay, E2E 37/37.
